summary: Iran restricts transit during the US and Israeli war on Iran. Ships need advance permission and political vetting, and permitted vessels use an Iranian-designated corridor along the northern coast under IRGC monitoring. Industry estimates cited in April put traffic nearly 95% below pre-crisis levels. Start month is when PortWatch tanker transits fell, from 43.5 a day in February to 0.9 in March.

sources.title: Maritime traffic through Strait of Hormuz remains restricted despite two-week ceasefire between Tehran & Washington

summary: The Houthis (Ansarallah) have declared a blockade on Saudi shipping in the Red Sea. On 2026-08-11 missiles struck the Egyptian-owned cargo ship Tihamah in the strait; Yemen's internationally recognised government blamed the Houthis and said at least six people were killed. The Houthis' Saba agency said the group attacked a Saudi ship. Start month is when PortWatch tanker transits fell, from 11.6 a day in July to 8.5 in August.

sources.title: Six killed in Houthi attack on Bab al-Mandeb ship, Yemen's government says
